node.title: XR low-core terminal shift-pair fiber bound
node.statement: For a distinct family F of a-subsets with pairwise intersections at most K-1=a-H, every oriented indicator-difference fiber of shift width t has a residual constant-weight code of length N-2t and distance at least 2H. Every fiber with t>=K has multiplicity at most one, since two records would share its fixed t-set; all such widths contribute at most |F|(|F|-1) to difference energy. More generally, terminal fibers with N-2t<=4H have multiplicity at most 8H and aggregate contribution at most 8H|F|(|F|-1). In P-B, global genericity proves distinct-support ownership. The only unresolved repeated-difference concentration lies in H<=t<=K-1. This is an exact Boolean additive-energy reduction; it does not prove the P-B slope count or CAP25's local locator-SPI input.
